title: Pacing strategy selection tests
condition: PacingStrategySelectionTests (factory + live SetStrategy), SettingsServiceHostTests (UpdateSettings applies PacingStrategy to the pump and round-trips it), and AttachPanelViewModelTests (pacing change flags pending, not restart).

acceptanceCriteria.text: SetStrategy on a not-started pump switches GateName immediately; unknown defaults to Semaphore
UpdateSettings with a VICE pacing strategy sets the pump gate to VICE and round-trips vice
